# WLKR UI

React and TypeScript source components, a shadcn-compatible registry, and opt-in WLKR typography.

Source: https://github.com/wlkr-si/ui. Build identity: /build-info.json.

## Animation room

[Animation room](/animation) tunes the real loader and wordmark with two rigid body pieces opening around the arc, frame scrubbing, loop or one-turn playback, geometry, direction and backgrounds. Copy a settings link to reproduce a paused frame without an account or backend. Settings do not automatically change the studio homepage.

## Pixel drawing

[Pixels](/pixels) is the focused drawing page. It reuses the gallery mask editor, ink, centred resize/crop, undo/redo, explicit Share and transparent SVG/PNG exports. React code opens on request. Transform offers horizontal/vertical flips and clockwise 90-degree rotation, preserving ink and size with one-step undo/redo. Open grid reads a local UTF-8 dot/hash file up to 4 KiB, keeping ink and one-step undo. Invalid, cancelled or stale reads leave artwork intact. Download grid saves exact dots/hash rows with one final newline in a size-based .txt file accepted by the Pixels CLI; ink stays in links or an explicit --ink flag. New canonical links use /pixels?mask=<token>#pixels; existing root v1/v2 links remain supported. No artwork is saved to a backend or browser storage.

[Pixels CLI source](https://github.com/wlkr-si/ui/blob/main/scripts/pixels.mjs): Node 24+ without dependency installation. Run node scripts/pixels.mjs --grid ./mask.txt or --mask <canonical-token>; --format url, json or svg. URL/JSON preserve theme-relative null ink. SVG is a flat regular grid requiring explicit ink, separate from browser snapshot exports. It uses the same canonical codec, makes no network requests, reads no credentials and writes only stdout. See the source README for file bounds and usage.

## Contrast CLI

[Contrast CLI instructions](https://github.com/wlkr-si/ui/blob/main/README.md#contrast-cli): Node 24+ with no dependency installation. Run node scripts/contrast.mjs <foreground> <background> [--json] [--suggest]. Two opaque six-digit colours use the unchanged browser helpers. JSON keeps exact ratios and explicit AA/AAA normal/large booleans; human display rounds ratios only. Optional AA text choices use bounded 5% RGB mixes toward black/white with a fixed background. No network, credentials or file input/output.

## Installation

Start with a React/Tailwind project configured by the standard shadcn CLI. Configure the @wlkr namespace as https://ui.wlkr.si/r/{name}.json.

pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @wlkr/footer-controls

Without configuring a namespace, install any item by URL: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://ui.wlkr.si/r/<name>.json

The CLI installs original source and pulls stock shadcn dependencies directly from upstream. No runtime component package, custom installer, or agent service is required.

## Components and styles

- [Button](/components/button): A button with six variants, four sizes and matching square icon sizes, width-preserving loading, aria-pressed toggling, asChild links and an optional animated spectrum rim. [Source JSON](/r/button.json)
- [Icon button](/components/icon-button): A round icon-only button with glass, plain and outline variants, four sizes that match Button and a brand-coloured toggle state. [Source JSON](/r/icon-button.json)
- [Segmented](/components/segmented): A single-choice control with an optional leading label and arrow-key navigation. [Source JSON](/r/segmented.json)
- [Select](/components/select): A native select with four control sizes, an optional prefix label and a chevron. [Source JSON](/r/select.json)
- [Input](/components/input): A native text input with two sizes, optional leading icon and clear button, and destructive invalid styling. [Source JSON](/r/input.json)
- [Combobox](/components/combobox): An editable combobox with accent-insensitive filtering, a listbox, keyboard navigation and a clear action. [Source JSON](/r/combobox.json)
- [Chip](/components/chip): A small pill toggle or static legend label with an optional leading colour swatch or icon. [Source JSON](/r/chip.json)
- [Menu](/components/menu): A menu button with a Bach Bench popover, arrow navigation, typeahead, separators, disabled actions and focus return. [Source JSON](/r/menu.json)
- [Card](/components/card): A Bach Bench card frame with seven composable sections, a 12px radius, hairline border and theme-aware surface. [Source JSON](/r/card.json)
- [Stat](/components/stat): A Bach Bench stat tile with a mono tabular value and optional note, plus a responsive two-to-four-column Stats grid. [Source JSON](/r/stat.json)
- [Copy command](/components/copy-command): A copyable command with honest clipboard feedback and a manual fallback. [Source JSON](/r/copy-command.json)
- [Async action](/components/async-action): Promise-aware action with pending, success, failure and retry states. [Source JSON](/r/async-action.json)
- [Hold action](/components/hold-action): A press-and-hold confirmation button with a pixel-stepped fill and a two-step fallback for assistive technology. [Source JSON](/r/hold-action.json)
- [Shortcut](/components/shortcut): Platform-aware keycaps that press with the real keys and run a handler when the combination lands. [Source JSON](/r/shortcut.json)
- [GitHub star](/components/github-star): A native repository link with an app-supplied count, rolling digits, green star fill, and a bounded burst. [Source JSON](/r/github-star.json)
- [Pixel button](/components/pixel-button): A button whose fill sweeps across as an ordered-dither grid of square pixels on hover and focus, with solid, outline and brand variants and a three-pixel loading state. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-button.json)
- [Filter list](/components/filter-list): An accessible searchable list with accent-insensitive matching and empty states. [Source JSON](/r/filter-list.json)
- [Scrub input](/components/scrub-input): A numeric text field whose label scrubs the value by dragging, with a tick ruler that glides with the number. [Source JSON](/r/scrub-input.json)
- [Code input](/components/code-input): A one-time-code field that draws a row of cells and a block caret over a single native input. [Source JSON](/r/code-input.json)
- [Pixel slider](/components/pixel-slider): A range slider drawn as a pixel grid with a dithered fill and a green thumb column, over a native range input. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-slider.json)
- [Liquid switch](/components/liquid-switch): A toggle switch whose thumb stretches, necks and snaps across the track like a drop of liquid. [Source JSON](/r/liquid-switch.json)
- [Dial](/components/dial): A rotary knob input drawn in SVG with a ring of ticks, a green current tick and a mono readout, driven by pointer drag and the keyboard. [Source JSON](/r/dial.json)
- [Pixel calendar](/components/pixel-calendar): A single-month date picker on a borderless seven-column grid with a solid selected block, a green pixel for today and full ARIA grid keyboard support. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-calendar.json)
- [Pixel canvas](/components/pixel-canvas): A pixel-art drawing pad: a grid of square cells you paint by click or drag in ink, WLKR green or erase, with keyboard control and a numeric value. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-canvas.json)
- [Pixel checkbox](/components/pixel-checkbox): A native checkbox whose square box fills with a 4x4 grid of pixels in ordered-dither order, with an indeterminate middle row. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-checkbox.json)
- [Pixel rating](/components/pixel-rating): A rating input made of square blocks: hover previews, click sets, and filled blocks pop in with a stepped stagger, the newest in WLKR green. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-rating.json)
- [Tag input](/components/tag-input): A token field on a single underline: Enter or comma adds a square mono tag, Backspace removes, paste splits on commas and newlines, and duplicates shake. [Source JSON](/r/tag-input.json)
- [Liquid tabs](/components/liquid-tabs): A keyboard-accessible segmented control with a liquid selection that stretches and snaps. [Source JSON](/r/liquid-tabs.json)
- [Index row](/components/index-row): Borderless index link with three fixed digits that roll on hover and focus. [Source JSON](/r/index-row.json)
- [Text link](/components/text-link): A normal text link with an optional keyboard-accessible Radix HoverCard preview. [Source JSON](/r/text-link.json)
- [Dock](/components/dock): A navigation row of square icon tiles that magnify around the pointer or keyboard focus from a fixed baseline. [Source JSON](/r/dock.json)
- [Scroll spy](/components/scroll-spy): An on-this-page list of section links with a liquid marker that tracks the section at the reading line. [Source JSON](/r/scroll-spy.json)
- [Steps](/components/steps): A numbered step indicator whose connecting line fills in pixel increments, with numbers that roll over to a pixel check and optional jump-back navigation. [Source JSON](/r/steps.json)
- [Pager](/components/pager): Pagination with previous and next arrows, a zero-padded page counter whose digits roll in the direction of travel, and a strip of page numbers. [Source JSON](/r/pager.json)
- [File tree](/components/file-tree): An accessible file tree with stepped pixel chevrons, animated folders, guide lines and full tree keyboard support. [Source JSON](/r/file-tree.json)
- [Scroll progress](/components/scroll-progress): A one-cell-tall strip of pixels pinned to the viewport edge, or inline, that fills as the page or a scroll container scrolls. [Source JSON](/r/scroll-progress.json)
- [Command menu](/components/command-menu): A command palette in a native modal dialog with a mono prompt, subsequence filtering, grouped commands, shortcuts and combobox ARIA. [Source JSON](/r/command-menu.json)
- [Crumbs](/components/crumbs): A mono breadcrumb trail with slash separators, a blinking block caret on the current page and a collapsible middle. [Source JSON](/r/crumbs.json)
- [Pop menu](/components/pop-menu): A dropdown menu button following the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern, with an outlined flat panel, stepped row reveal and an inverted active row. [Source JSON](/r/pop-menu.json)
- [Pixel progress](/components/pixel-progress): An accessible pixel-grid progress bar with a dithered leading edge and an indeterminate state. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-progress.json)
- [WLKR loader](/components/wlkr-loader): A tunable Open Lens loader with optional liquid split-body motion, a hover bounce, pause and reduced-motion support. [Source JSON](/r/wlkr-loader.json)
- [Toaster](/components/toaster): Ink-block toast notifications with a draining pixel timer, called from anywhere with toast(). [Source JSON](/r/toaster.json)
- [Status dot](/components/status-dot): An inline status indicator: a small square dot with a label, a pixel-stepped ping when live and a caret blink when busy. [Source JSON](/r/status-dot.json)
- [Pixel skeleton](/components/pixel-skeleton): A loading placeholder for text, blocks and avatars, drawn as a checker texture with a stepped pixel band sweeping across. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-skeleton.json)
- [Shimmer text](/components/shimmer-text): Inline status text in a quiet grey with a stepped, dithered band of brighter text passing through it while work is in progress. [Source JSON](/r/shimmer-text.json)
- [Dither dialog](/components/dither-dialog): A modal dialog on the native dialog element with an ordered-dither backdrop that steps in through three densities and a square panel that snaps into place. [Source JSON](/r/dither-dialog.json)
- [Hint](/components/hint): A tooltip that shows a solid mono label beside its trigger on hover or keyboard focus, with a stepped clip reveal and viewport flipping. [Source JSON](/r/hint.json)
- [Pixel spinner](/components/pixel-spinner): A family of inline loading indicators drawn on a 3x3 pixel grid, animated with stepped CSS keyframes in six patterns. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-spinner.json)
- [Rolling number](/components/rolling-number): A formatted number whose digits roll to each new value like an odometer. [Source JSON](/r/rolling-number.json)
- [Dot matrix](/components/dot-matrix): A dot-matrix display with a built-in 5×7 font and stepped scrolling for long messages. [Source JSON](/r/dot-matrix.json)
- [Countdown](/components/countdown): A countdown to a target time with days, hours, minutes and seconds on rolling digit wheels, a hydration-safe placeholder and one shared wall-clock ticker. [Source JSON](/r/countdown.json)
- [Pixel bars](/components/pixel-bars): A bar chart drawn as stacks of square cells that build up on view, with a hover and keyboard readout. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-bars.json)
- [Heat grid](/components/heat-grid): An activity grid of days by week, shaded in four ink steps with the busiest days in brand green. [Source JSON](/r/heat-grid.json)
- [Pixel avatar](/components/pixel-avatar): A deterministic, symmetric pixel identicon drawn from any string, with optional image and an overlapping group. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-avatar.json)
- [Secret field](/components/secret-field): A masked API key or token field that decodes on reveal, re-masks on a timer and copies without showing the value. [Source JSON](/r/secret-field.json)
- [Diff view](/components/diff-view): A unified line-level text diff with old and new line numbers, a sign column, hatched removed lines and collapsible unchanged runs. [Source JSON](/r/diff-view.json)
- [Ring meter](/components/ring-meter): A radial progress meter drawn as discrete SVG segments, with a green leading tick, stepped fill transitions and a mono value in the centre. [Source JSON](/r/ring-meter.json)
- [Sparkline](/components/sparkline): A small inline SVG trend line drawn as pixel steps, with an optional dithered fill and pointer or keyboard scrubbing. [Source JSON](/r/sparkline.json)
- [Page intro](/components/page-intro): Gallery typography with a width-stable binary heading reveal. [Source JSON](/r/page-intro.json)
- [Decode text](/components/decode-text): Inline text that resolves out of glyph noise on view, hover or focus, with a stable width. [Source JSON](/r/decode-text.json)
- [Typewriter](/components/typewriter): Inline text that types a phrase, holds, deletes back to the beginning it shares with the next and types that, behind a block caret. [Source JSON](/r/typewriter.json)
- [Marker](/components/marker): Inline emphasis that draws a highlight, underline or strike through its words in discrete steps, across line breaks, on view, mount or hover. [Source JSON](/r/marker.json)
- [Terminal](/components/terminal): A self-playing terminal session that types commands behind a block caret and lands output a row at a time, at its final height from the first frame. [Source JSON](/r/terminal.json)
- [Ticker](/components/ticker): A constant-speed marquee that eases to a stop on hover and focus, drags with momentum, and steps out at the edges. [Source JSON](/r/ticker.json)
- [Segment display](/components/segment-display): A seven-segment SVG readout for numbers, a few letters and a live clock, with ghost segments and a stepped colon blink. [Source JSON](/r/segment-display.json)
- [Split flap](/components/split-flap): A split-flap text display: square ink cells that step through a character set, staggered left to right, whenever the value changes. [Source JSON](/r/split-flap.json)
- [Pixel object](/components/pixel-object): A projected pixel sphere, custom point cloud or mask, with rotation, flicker patterns, shape morphing and considerate motion controls. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-object.json)
- [Pixel image](/components/pixel-image): An image that resolves from coarse colour blocks to the real picture when it enters view. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-image.json)
- [Compare](/components/compare): A before-and-after comparison with a draggable, clickable and keyboard-controlled divider. [Source JSON](/r/compare.json)
- [Pixel wave](/components/pixel-wave): An audio meter of square-cell bars for listening, speaking and recording states, driven by a microphone stream, a supplied level or a simulation. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-wave.json)
- [Dot field](/components/dot-field): A canvas dot grid that swells, tints and springs away from the pointer, with a slow ambient wave. [Source JSON](/r/dot-field.json)
- [Dither field](/components/dither-field): A canvas background that renders a slow, soft light field through an ordered-dither matrix as crisp one-bit pixels, with children on top. [Source JSON](/r/dither-field.json)
- [Pixel trail](/components/pixel-trail): A wrapper with an invisible grid whose cells light up under the pointer and switch off in stepped pixels, leaving a short blocky trail. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-trail.json)
- [Dissolve](/components/dissolve): A wrapper that reveals or hides any content through a 4×4 ordered-dither mask, on view, on mount or on command. [Source JSON](/r/dissolve.json)
- [Magnetic](/components/magnetic): A wrapper that pulls its children a little way toward a nearby pointer on a spring, with a deeper parallax layer, and springs them home on leave. [Source JSON](/r/magnetic.json)
- [Binary rain](/components/binary-rain): A decorative canvas background of stepped, falling binary columns with a brand-green head and an ordered fade, with content layered on top. [Source JSON](/r/binary-rain.json)
- [Pixel burst](/components/pixel-burst): A wrapper that throws a stepped burst of square ink and green pixels from the click point, or on demand through a ref. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-burst.json)
- [Theme toggle](/components/theme-toggle): A basic shadcn Toggle that switches light and dark themes, follows the system until chosen and remembers the choice. [Source JSON](/r/theme-toggle.json)
- [Footer controls](/components/footer-controls): Compact system, light and dark theme controls with a link to a real app-owned plain-text page for agents. [Source JSON](/r/footer-controls.json)
- [WLKR theme](/components/theme): The WLKR design tokens: neutral and brand primitives, semantic light and dark roles, and the control, type, space, radius, elevation and motion scales, with shadcn/ui aliases. [Source JSON](/r/theme.json)
- [WLKR typography](/components/typography): Opt-in exact gallery typography and layout, with semantic legacy token bridges. [Source JSON](/r/typography.json)

Each component has its own page at /components/<name> with a live preview, install command, usage, API and source. FooterControls receives a real app-owned agentHref; this text file is that destination here. It is plain documentation, with no external AI server or agent execution.
